description: Harden agent-safety-gateway from local MVP and Codex demo integration into a more verifiable execution-control gateway with guarded execution APIs, Codex evidence, management visibility, and dry-run adapter readiness.

browserVerification.note: The current local Node is 18.19.1. Vite 7 dev server requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+. Until Node is upgraded, use the built dist with a static server or record this blocker.

userStories.title: Add guarded execution API for SQL dry-run flow
userStories.description: As a gateway integrator, I want an API endpoint that performs analysis and guarded execution in one server-side call so that executorInvoked and executorResult are captured by the gateway boundary instead of being inferred by an external MCP wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an API route for guarded SQL execution that accepts a ToolCallRequest and returns status, executorInvoked, decision, riskLevel, auditId, and executorResult
The route must use ToolExecutionGuard or an equivalent shared server-side guard path before invoking any executor
Prohibited production DELETE on orders returns blocked and executorInvoked=false
Allowed read-only SELECT returns executed only when a configured safe executor is available; otherwise it returns a fail-closed not-configured result without pretending execution happened
Add API tests for blocked DELETE and allowed/not-configured SELECT behavior
Typecheck passes
Relevant API tests pass
userStories.notes: This closes the current split where MCP calls /api/tool-calls/analyze and then performs local dry-run handling outside the API.

userStories.title: Persist Codex hook decisions as audit evidence
userStories.description: As a security reviewer, I want Codex PreToolUse hook decisions to be persisted when a command is blocked so that management and evidence pages can show what Codex attempted and why it was stopped.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a local hook-decision repository or audit extension that records Codex hook input summary, adapted ToolCallRequest when available, block reason, and timestamp
Gateway-backed hook blocks are linked to the auditId returned by /api/tool-calls/analyze
Local-only hook blocks such as destructive host commands are recorded without requiring a ToolCallRequest
The hook still returns should_block=true for prohibited SQL DELETE and fails closed when gateway analysis is unavailable
Add tests covering gateway-backed block persistence and local-only block persistence
Typecheck passes
Codex adapter/hook tests pass
userStories.notes: Current management UI can see gateway audits, but not local-only hook blocks.

userStories.title: Expose execution logs and hook decisions through read-only API endpoints
userStories.description: As an operator, I want read-only API endpoints for executor logs and Codex hook decisions so that the management UI can display both gateway decisions and actual execution-control outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET endpoints for execution logs and Codex hook decisions with simple filters by requestId, auditId, toolType, decision, and environment where applicable
Endpoints are read-only and never trigger analysis or executor invocation
Responses use the same error envelope as existing API routes
Add API tests for list and filter behavior
Typecheck passes
API tests pass
userStories.notes: Builds on ASG-002 persistence and existing execution-log-repository.

userStories.title: Show Codex interception and executor status in management UI
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the management UI to show whether a request came from Codex, whether the hook blocked it, and whether any executor was invoked so that I can visually confirm interception effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit list or detail view shows source actor, decision, riskLevel, and executorInvoked or hook-blocked status when available
Add a Codex interception section to audit detail or a dedicated tab that reads the new hook-decision API
Blocked SQL DELETE from Codex is visible in the UI with auditId and block reason
Local-only hook blocks are visible in the UI even when there is no gateway auditId
UI API client tests are updated for new endpoints
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using validationContext.browserVerification
userStories.notes: Frontend story. Use static dist server if Node 18 prevents Vite dev server startup.

userStories.title: Harden Codex MCP server protocol and add contract tests
userStories.description: As a Codex integrator, I want the MCP server behavior covered by tests so that tool listing and tool calls remain compatible with Codex after future changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests for initialize, tools/list, gateway_health, safe_sql blocked DELETE, and safe_sql allowed SELECT not-configured executor behavior
MCP responses include valid JSON-RPC id, result or error, content, and structuredContent where applicable
Malformed JSON-RPC input returns a parse error without crashing the process
Document any intentional MCP limitations in docs/integration/codex-integration.md
Typecheck or syntax checks pass for services/codex
Codex MCP tests pass
userStories.notes: Current MCP server is dependency-free and hand-rolled; contract tests reduce integration risk.

userStories.title: Add real dry-run profile validation and fail-closed diagnostics
userStories.description: As an operator, I want dry-run executor configuration to be validated before use so that missing or unsafe SQL, CI/CD, or config sandbox settings fail closed with actionable diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate ASG_SQL_DRY_RUN_COMMAND, ASG_CICD_DRY_RUN_COMMAND, and ASG_CONFIG_SANDBOX_COMMAND formats before executor invocation
Reject shell-string commands and require JSON string arrays
Add health or diagnostic output showing configured, not_configured, or invalid status for each dry-run executor
Never invoke a dry-run command when validation fails
Add unit tests for valid, missing, malformed, and unsafe executor command configuration
Typecheck or syntax checks pass
Codex executor tests pass

userStories.title: Expand SQL risk parsing for broad destructive operations
userStories.description: As a database safety owner, I want destructive SQL such as DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER, and DELETE without WHERE to be classified safely so that unsupported syntax is blocked with clear evidence instead of only local hook rejection.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL parser recognizes or explicitly rejects DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER, and DELETE without WHERE with structured parse or risk errors
Production DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER against matched or unresolved resources results in block or prohibited-level risk
DELETE without WHERE includes a risk factor explaining broad table deletion
Add tests for DROP TABLE orders, TRUNCATE orders, ALTER TABLE orders, and DELETE FROM orders
Typecheck passes
API SQL parser and risk tests pass
userStories.notes: Current hook blocks some unsupported destructive SQL before gateway parsing; better evidence comes from the gateway itself.

userStories.title: Generate Codex integration evidence report
userStories.description: As a patent and validation reviewer, I want a reproducible evidence report for Codex interception so that RV evidence covers the real Codex adapter, MCP tool, hook, gateway decision, and UI audit path.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a repeatable script or test that runs a Codex-style SQL DELETE hook simulation and captures hook output, auditId, decision, riskLevel, and executorInvoked=false
Write a Markdown report under docs/evidence/real-validation for the Codex SQL DELETE interception path
Update docs/evidence/real-validation/summary.md with the Codex evidence row and its mock/real-component status
The report distinguishes simulated PreToolUse input from an interactive Codex session
Typecheck or syntax checks pass
Evidence generation command is documented
userStories.notes: Use the current manually verified audit path as the starting point, but make it repeatable.

userStories.title: Add authentication and CORS hardening plan for gateway API
userStories.description: As a deployment owner, I want the API boundary documented and minimally configurable so that local demos remain open but non-local deployments do not expose analysis and audit endpoints without controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Add configuration for allowed CORS origin instead of unconditional wildcard in non-local mode
Add optional bearer-token middleware that can protect API routes when ASG_API_TOKEN is configured
Health endpoint remains accessible without leaking sensitive configuration
Docs explain local demo mode versus protected deployment mode
Add API tests for open local mode and token-protected mode
Typecheck passes
API tests pass
userStories.notes: Current server sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* for all requests.

userStories.title: Stabilize local startup for Node and pnpm environments
userStories.description: As a developer, I want local start commands to clearly handle Node 18 versus Vite 7 requirements and user-local pnpm installs so that API and management UI verification is repeatable.
acceptanceCriteria: Update local start documentation to mention Node 20.19+ requirement for Vite dev server
Document the user-local pnpm fallback path used in this environment
Add a script or runbook section for serving built apps/web/dist when Vite dev server is unavailable
local:status or documentation explains which ports should be running for API and Web
No production code behavior changes are required
Documentation-only validation command is recorded
userStories.notes: This captures the current Node 18 blocker observed during Web dev server startup.
